name: calorie-steward-windows
description: Privacy-first Windows desktop edition of Calorie Steward

scripts.export:web: npm --prefix ../mobile-app run verify && npm --prefix ../mobile-app run export:web:windows
scripts.verify: npm run audit:all && node scripts/verify-attribution.cjs && npm test && npm run export:web && node scripts/verify-export.cjs && npm run test:desktop
scripts.build:github: npm run verify && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis zip --x64
scripts.build:github-portable: npm run verify && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win zip --x64
scripts.build:store: npm run verify && cross-env CALORIE_STORE_BUILD=1 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win appx --x64
